newsitem.title: INDIA: Port conditions update - India - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - India - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
MUMBAI, Sept 23 - Berthing position, 38 vessels berthed alongside port and 49 anchored off Mumbai floating light awaiting orders. No delays.
JAWAHARLAL NEHRU, Sept 23 - Three to four days delay for container vessels, 10 to 12 days for bulk vessels.
KANDLA, Sept 23 - Berthing position, 16 cargo vessels and five oil vessels berthed alongside port, 11 cargo vessels and 11 oil vessels anchored off roads awaiting berths.
